verdict.rationale: Gitea exposes a versioned REST API under /api/v1, with Swagger/OpenAPI documents and per-release docs. The vendor's own API guide says no deprecation or backward-compatibility statement exists in the guide, FAQ, or per-release docs, so only the versioning half of the story is delivered. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, a backward-compatibility or breaking-change guarantee, and any independent corroboration of API stability across releases.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: with every example against the versioned /api/v1 base, and the docs site keeps per-release versions (29-dev back through 1.22)
